name: tpl-existence-3-goal
task: Get into the locked room. Pick up the ball.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) requires the ball to be picked up, and Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up) ensures the room is entered before that happens. Together, these correctly capture the requested sequence, and since the first step is forced by the second via the precedence chain, its own Existence clause is redundant and correctly omitted.

texts: Get into the locked room before picking up the ball.
